answer: Require every agent to lock a scarce token stake before trading, and cap influence by the amount locked. If signed trade receipts prove an agent double-spent, a challenge can slash its stake. Creating many identities therefore multiplies the capital the attacker must immobilize and risk losing; a sybil farm cannot gain influence for free. At the wharf, a glacier-long settlement window gives peers time to submit receipts, while ferrous tokens name the collateral, not a defense by themselves.
